title: Accounts
description: Real personal bank-account balances, hand-read off the bank at the end of a month. Not bookkeeping: there are no transactions here, just "this is what was actually in the account when the month closed". A balance read at the end of month M opens month M+1's rolling budget, and from there it is carried forward month by month (opening + net income - private expenses), so it genuinely depletes. Months at or before M ignore it entirely — a past balance isn't known and isn't guessed. Business accounts are deliberately not modelled: company money is spent down rather than accumulated, so there is no business balance to carry. Hand-edited and committed via git.

balance.description: Euros, decimals allowed (e.g. 1427.42). May be negative for an overdrawn account.

as_of.description: The month-end date this balance was read, e.g. "2026-07-31". It is the CLOSING balance of that month, so it becomes the OPENING balance of the next one: a balance dated 2026-07-31 is August's starting figure and has no effect on July. Only the month matters; the day is informational. All accounts are combined into one balance anchored at the latest as_of among them, so read them together — a stale entry silently drags the whole figure.

note.description: Free-text context, shown next to the account name. Not used in any computation.
